review.finding: ActivityCard.subrunnerId's doc comment still described the disproven initial hand-back-message design instead of the corrected provisional-id/ack-overwrite/task-notification design.
review.suggestion: Update the field doc to describe the corrected mechanism.

review.finding: The corrected subrunner resolution mechanism (extractSubrunnerAgentId, applySubrunnerAck, resolveSubrunnerNotification) had essentially no direct test coverage, and no reducer-level test exercised the harness's real dispatch tool name 'Agent' at all.
review.suggestion: Add unit tests directly against missionActivityFeedSubrunner.ts's exports covering dispatch -> ack -> task-notification, plus one end-to-end test using tool name 'Agent'.

review.finding: No test covered the new subrunner rendering branch (running dot, resolved report-link button, inline-fallback).
review.suggestion: Add MissionActivityFeedCard.test.tsx cases for all three subrunner render states.

review.finding: New SubrunnerPanel component had no dedicated test file, and MissionBody.test.tsx had no case for the new activeNode = subrunner:<id> wiring.
review.suggestion: Add SubrunnerPanel.test.tsx and a MissionBody.test.tsx case that opens the panel from a resolved subrunner card.

review.finding: The one PR-card test unknowingly exercised the new item-1 dedup-suppression path but asserted nothing about it; no companion test proved a genuinely different narrative sentence stays visible.
review.suggestion: Add positive/negative assertions for the PR-title dedup suppression.

review.finding: The subrunner PendingTool.commandKey was hardcoded to the 'Agent' literal even when tool.name === 'Task', inconsistent with every other bucket in the file.
review.suggestion: Use tool.name instead of the hardcoded literal.

summary: The extraction into missionActivityFeedSubrunner.ts (createSubrunnerDispatchCard / applySubrunnerAck) was clean: correct types, updated call sites, no dead branches, no unused imports, no circular imports. Items 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 were all implemented as specified with direct regression tests. missionActivityFeedResolve.ts (300 lines) and missionActivityFeedTurn.ts (294 lines) are back under the bloat ceiling via the extraction. All 6 findings (1 high, 3 medium, 2 low) were addressed by the implementer: stale doc comment fixed, full test coverage added for the resolution mechanism (including an Agent-named end-to-end test), subrunner UI render states tested, SubrunnerPanel + MissionBody wiring tested, PR-dedup positive/negative regression added, and the commandKey nit fixed.
